thread:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: final review form cutoff moved to 2026-04-07 17:00 PDT due to UTC payroll sync. Please finish manager signoffs by then.
Ken (Manager): Clarify  cutoff: is that the deadline to submit numeric scores or to hit the 'submit final' button?
Maya (People Ops): Hit the 'submit final' button by 17:00 PDT. Drafts fine earlier, but we need sealed submissions for calibration.
Olivia (Manager): I have two managers still waiting on upward feedback. Is there an extension pathway for exceptional cases?
Maya (People Ops): We have a 24h limited exception window for medical/leave emergencies. File the extension request form (link in #docs) and tag @people-ops. Approvals after cutoff are rare.
Sam (Eng): What's the SLA for people-ops to respond to extension requests?
Rina (People Ops): We aim for <4h during working hours, <24h off-hours. If you're in a crunch, DM and well prioritize.
HRBot: Reminder: reviewer training drop-ins posted for Wed/Thu 30m blocks. Sign up: https://rwd.co/calib-dropins :calendar:
Ken (Manager): Are the drop-ins mandatory for first-time reviewers?
Maya (People Ops): Mandatory for first-time reviewers AND any manager who requests a buddy. Otherwise strongly recommended.
Olivia (Manager): Any change to promotion nomination criteria this cycle?
Maya (People Ops): No rubric changes. Only change: promotion nominations require a short 1-paragraph growth plan attached to the form. We want evidence + expected next-level scope.
Sam (Eng): How do we document calibration dissent? If a manager disagrees with cross-org outcome, is there an appeals path?
Maya (People Ops): Yes. Post-cross-org, managers can file a dissent note within 72h. People Ops will triage and potentially convene an adjudication panel (3 senior managers + one People Ops). Dissent does not block payroll changes while under review.
Ken (Manager): For contractors and conversion cases, what's the escalation flow?
Rina (People Ops): Conversions: org micro -> conversion panel (finance + hiring partner) -> final cross-org. Use the "conversion" checkbox on the form so Ops picks it up.
HRBot: Auto-check: forms with missing manager signature will be flagged 12h before cutoff.
Olivia (Manager): Can we record calibration sessions for posterity? Some of my team are APAC and may miss nuance.
Maya (People Ops): Recording allowed if you set access to company-internal only and delete after 45 days. Add that note in session doc.
Sam (Eng): If a manager is swapping out later, what's the handoff package?
Maya (People Ops): Minimal: current draft feedback + last 2 peer feedback excerpts + quick sentence on open questions. Paste into the backfill column in the tracker.
Ken (Manager): Any embargo on sharing preliminary ratings with ICs?
Rina (People Ops): Embargo: DO NOT share final or indicative ratings until after manager 1:1s start on 2026-04-10. You can share development feedback earlier but not final ratings.
Maya (People Ops): Final note: were releasing a one-page "Manager Quick Guide" with checklists and the appeal template by EOD. Ping @people-ops for urgent help. Thanks all :pray:
